name: dock-profiler
description: A macOS app for Dock profiles, with an optional desktop (Space + wallpaper) attached to each one.

scripts.sign: CODESIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | sed -n 's/.*"\(Developer ID Application: [^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)}" ./Scripts/build_app.sh --zip
scripts.notarize: CODESIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | sed -n 's/.*"\(Developer ID Application: [^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)}" ./Scripts/build_app.sh --notarize
scripts.release: CODESIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | sed -n 's/.*"\(Developer ID Application: [^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)}" ./Scripts/build_app.sh --notarize --dmg
